purpose: Read-only, bounded and portable context window for independent agents across chats; restore authoritative intent while selecting only fresh provenance-bearing context from existing domain owners.
invocation: compile_agent_context(handoff, records, intent, query_key, capture_ref, now, budget_chars)

handoff.transition: source-qualified evidence_ref required; parent and household scope cannot silently change

routing_semantics: Names and descriptions are allowlisted read-only owner suggestions, NOT callable connections and NOT proof of actual retrieval. The owner independently performs authorized lookup before using advice.

bounds.unit: actual JSON character estimate, NOT tokens or measured model context usage

conflicts: Same fact_id with divergent claims, owners or revisions is excluded; stale and candidates are not promoted.
invariants: Never replace, truncate or dilute parent objective, corrections, rejected paths or blockers to fit a context budget
Missing or inadequate mandatory context fails closed; no speculative context compression
Wrong household, game build or capture observations deny even if the claim is plausible
Read-only records do not override real-time player intent, selected Sim queue, fresh authorization or scene/save/lot gates
Graph retrieval is conditional on relationship questions and sourced edges; no graph query is a required stage
Host evaluation may expose packet optionally but cannot use it to change the effect admission decision
No profile discovery, arbitrary save/file writes, background agent, telemetry, raw chat logging or new OS hooks
Never claim an agent was installed, a tool executed, or a native Sims outcome was observed from an offline packet
active_parent: BI-002 hunger certification remains active; this context service is nonblocking.

agent_control_path.rule: Context cannot itself issue an input permit, but an opted-in agent MAY operate Sims as the LAST RESORT through the existing CooperativeScreenQueue and explicit listener. Every atomic action must be journaled, observed and queued for reviewed repository codification.
